subject: Private VPC patch shiproom: pinning, canary, rollback owners
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Sam Thomas <sam.thomas@edgebank.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC patch shiproom: pinning, canary, rollback owners

Team —

We need to lock down the operational plan for EdgeBank's private deployment patch on Wed (2026-06-02). High-level asks:

- Confirm version pinning per service (see attached pinning-matrix-v1.xlsx).
- Define canary cohort (1 region, 2 nodes) and success metrics.
- Assign rollback owners and exact abort criteria.
- Clarify maintenance window and traffic steering (EdgeBank prefers 02:00-04:00 UTC).

I've attached a short agenda PDF for the shiproom and a starter rollback-checklist. Please review before the midday sync. Sam / Akash — tagging you for acceptance of the maintenance window and to confirm David's SRE can be on the bridge.

Initial proposals (short):
- Pin inference runtime to v2.9.1 for 48 hours, then allow auto-roll to v2.9.2 if no regressions.
- Canary: route 3% traffic for 2 hours, prove latency P95 uplift <10ms and error rate <0.1%.
- Rollback: immediate unpin and redeploy previous pinned artifact if tokenization errors >0.5% or KV cache inconsistencies observed.

Please reply with owners for each bullet by EOD.

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Global Customer Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20260530-maintenance-agenda.pdf, pinning-matrix-v1.xlsx, rollback-checklist.txt

From: Sam Thomas <sam.thomas@edgebank.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Akash Rao <akash@edgeops.net>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC patch shiproom: pinning, canary, rollback owners

Rishi —

Thanks for the heads up. 02:00-04:00 UTC works for us; David (our SRE lead) will be on the bridge. From our side:

- Maintenance window approved.
- Canary cohort fine. We want one additional check: post-canary traffic replay of a representative batch job (transactions dump) to validate embeddings stability.
- If KV cache drift is detected, we want automatic fallback to the current pinned snapshot + an out-of-band incident created in our PagerDuty.

I'll ask David to share a short checklist for the replay job tomorrow morning.

Sam
Head of Platform Ops, EdgeBank

Subject: Re: Private VPC patch shiproom: pinning, canary, rollback owners

Rishi / team —

I can own the version-pinning runbook and the post-deploy regressions checklist. Actions I will take:

1) Verify pinning-matrix for model-serving, router, and transformer-runtime by EOD Monday.
2) Add a step to explicitly preserve model KV snapshots pre-patch and verify checksums after canary.
3) Prepare a short Helm override and render for the pinned artifacts so Ops can apply atomically.

Question: are we ok with a 48-hour pin window, or should we move to 72 hours for financial customers? Sam — your call.

Monica
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Akash Rao <akash@edgeops.net>, Sam Thomas <sam.thomas@edgebank.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 13:51:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC patch shiproom: pinning, canary, rollback owners

All —

I will take ownership of canary orchestration and the automated metrics gating. Plan:

- Canary deployment: replicate one rack (2 nodes) in us-west-2; route 3% production through traffic-splitter.
- Monitoring: wire a short dashboard (P95 latency, 5xx rate, tokenization errors, KV drift metric). Link in the shiproom console by T-2.
- Automated gate: if any of the thresholds trip during the 2-hour canary, route back 100% and trigger the rollback checklist.

Two technical notes:
- We should snapshot KV cache pre-patch and persist to S3 vault with a short TTL; snapshots are required for deterministic rollback.
- For embedding stability tests, we will run the replay in a staging namespace that mirrors EdgeBank's index to avoid contaminating production indices. Monica, I will coordinate the helm overrides.

Karthik
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Private VPC patch shiproom: pinning, canary, rollback owners

Rishi / all —

EdgeOps confirms: 48 hours is acceptable as long as we get a checklist entry that forces a manual acceptance at T+24. We'll keep a dedicated on-call for the 48-hour pin. A few requests from our side:

- Please provide an out-of-band signed attest for the patch artifacts (checksum + provenance). We will need that for our audit.
- Network plan: ensure the upgrade does not change egress IPs or NAT mappings; our firewall rules are tight.
- If rollback is triggered, we prefer a partial-service downgrade first (route inference traffic to fallback cluster) before a full-scale redeploy to avoid redistributing connections.

Sam — David will coordinate the replay checklist with Monica.

Akash
Principal SRE, EdgeOps (EdgeBank partner)

Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 16:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC patch shiproom: pinning, canary, rollback owners

Thanks everyone — good alignment. A few follow-ups and owners (final):

- Version pinning runbook: Monica (owner). Deliverable: Helm override + rendered manifest. Deadline: Mon 2026-06-01 17:00 PT.
- Canary orchestration + gates + dashboard: Karthik (owner). Deliverable: shiproom dashboard link + automated gate configured. Deadline: Tue 2026-06-01 12:00 PT.
- KV snapshot + checksums + artifact attest: Dev (owner, coordinate with Akash). Deliverable: snapshot S3 path and signed checksums. Deadline: Tue 2026-06-01 17:00 PT.
- External acceptance & replay checklist: Sam/David (EdgeBank). Deliverable: replay checklist link. Deadline: Tue 2026-06-01 12:00 PT.

Operational notes:
- If the canary gate trips, the automated gate will revert traffic to pre-canary state and the shiproom runbook triggers the rollback checklists.
- Rollback ladder: partial traffic fallback -> KV snapshot restore -> redeploy pinned artifact. Exact rollback owner sequence is in rollback-checklist.txt (attached).

I'll schedule a 30-minute shiproom for Tue 2026-06-01 09:30 PT to run through the final steps. Invite coming shortly.

Rishi
Director, Global Customer Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pinning-matrix-v1.xlsx, rollback-checklist.txt
